title: DARPA N3 brain-machine interface program

tellings.quote: That year DARPA launched a program called N3, [music] next generation non-surgical neurotechnology.

plain: In 2018 DARPA, the Pentagon's research agency, launched a programme called N3, short for next-generation non-surgical neurotechnology, to link brains and machines without surgery. Michels brings it up himself, without naming a source, in an episode about a UFO book he says the Pentagon tried to censor, where it would point to government interest in reaching into the mind.
